templates.name: Broadsheet
templates.tagline: A talking head cut like a newspaper coming alive
best_for: anyone with a point to make fast
does: punch-ins every ~1.6 s across three framings
a newsprint page every 6-8 s (kicker, headline, deck, engraving)
pages slapped in and whipped out
clipping captions (white serif on tilted black paper strips)
byline name tag
number cards, logo tiles, object pop-ups, one type slam
intros and fillers cut
warm newsprint grade, groovy bed
templates.note: First attempt rejected by Ahmed (29 Sep): rebuild from his reference examples.

templates.name: Folio
templates.tagline: Calm, premium talking head with editorial collage pages
does: hook page at 2-4 s on the spoken words
collage pages with an engraving on every page
name tag from the first frame
number cards on enumerations
logo tiles when a tool is named
object pop-ups with a word label
one type slam
serif captions in a phrase-sized box
face-centred framing and colour matching
lo-fi bed with drops
paper, pen and zoom sound layer
opening burn in the brand colour

templates.name: The Monk
templates.tagline: One locked shot, quiet serif captions

templates.name: The Headline
templates.tagline: Condensed caps captions and B-roll on every named subject

templates.name: The Monk 3
templates.tagline: Quiet serif captions, big enough to read on a phone
templates.note: Look ported from Ahmed's Monk 3.1 (his showcase: 6/6 SHIP on hand-planned reels). The hand planning, window finder and LUFS mastering are not part of the style. See the style file's _about for what was left out.

templates.name: The Keynote 3
templates.tagline: Bigger script keywords and a cleaner caption line, no grey boxes
templates.note: Look ported from Ahmed's Keynote 3.1 (6/6 SHIP on hand-planned clips). Face-aware crop, face-safe light leaks and mastering are not ported; music stays off.

templates.name: The Headline 2
templates.tagline: Condensed caps with a punch-in every second and a half
templates.note: Look ported from Ahmed's Headline 2.1 (6/6 SHIP on hand-planned reels). His Wikimedia B-roll with name labels is not ported: the studio planner cannot place fetched stills.

templates.name: Noir
templates.tagline: Black-and-white cinema documentary: letterbox bars, serif subtitles with one gold word, slow push-ins, chapter cards
templates.note: Look ported from Ahmed's Noir (premium-noir, public BETA on his side). Needs no B-roll. The piano bed (silent-descent) is not shipped in this fork, so the reel builds without music (music.optional); chapter cards are optional endcard beats (variant caps, font serif). His noir_score.py sound pass is not part of the style. Colour variants premium-noir-ice / -jade / -red / -rose / -silver are styles only, as with the other colour themes.

templates.name: Podcast Glow
templates.tagline: A boring podcast clip turned into a punchy reel: glow captions, huge headline words, sets behind the speaker
templates.note: Look ported from Ahmed's Podcast Glow. The cut-out sets (stage.windows) need the person-segmentation matte, which is slow on CPU; without stage the look is glow captions + headlines over the warm-graded footage. Headlines are written by scripts/glow_plan.py (not wired into the studio). The bed is optional (not shipped) and the premium sound pack is not shipped. Colour variants podcast-glow-blue / -green / -pink / -purple / -red / -white are styles only.

templates.name: Chrome Motion
templates.tagline: Real footage with a cinematic grade, and a chrome 3D object or a clean motion graphic on the key beats
templates.note: Look ported from Ahmed's Gadzhi / Chrome Motion. Needs a planner to place the gm-* scene beats (his director is not ported). The 3D objects are AI-generated (Higgsfield Nano Banana Pro) with no row in the asset ledger yet: confirm they may ship before this leaves beta. The bed is optional (not shipped). Colour themes gadzhi-blue / -green / -red / -yellow are styles only.

templates.name: Authority
templates.tagline: A clean authority edit: red title box, name card, split-screen numbered list, heavy-keyword captions
templates.note: Look ported from Ahmed's Hormozi. The beats (hz-title / hz-name / hz-list / hz-note) are planned by scripts/focus_director.py (standalone, not wired into the studio; its optional AI review needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY). The bed is optional (not shipped). Colour variants hormozi-blue / -green / -orange / -purple / -teal are styles only.

templates.name: Breakdown
templates.tagline: A fast numbered teaching reel: one word at a time, chapter cards with giant numerals, punch-ins every second or so
does: one word on screen at a time under the face
a navy title card on the hook
full-screen chapter cards with a giant numeral that change colour per step
a typewriter label over the promise
the call-to-action keyword pinned in a gradient to the end
punch-ins every ~1.2 s, sound effects only on section changes
footage keeps its own colour; the music bed is optional
templates.note: Colour versions (red, emerald, orange, purple, pink) exist as samples only; the engine has no styles for them yet.

templates.name: Podcast
templates.tagline: Moody podcast-clip look: heavy white caps, yellow key words, a question box on the hook, a Like button that gets clicked
does: 1-3 words at a time in heavy white caps on the lower third
key words in yellow, danger words in red
the hook question in a white box with an arrowed name label
a pull quote mid-video in the same box
an animated Like button and a pinned show logo
punch-ins every ~2 s, contrasty colour picture, low cinematic bed (optional)
templates.note: Colour versions (cyan, green, pink, orange, purple) exist as samples only; the engine has no styles for them yet.

templates.name: Gold Ledger
templates.tagline: Warm talking head with a small italic lead line, one big gold keyword, and white UI cards over the footage
does: opens on a white page with the line typed on over a map
a small italic lead line with one big heavy keyword in a gold gradient
white map card and a checklist of pills, one per spoken item
quick white wash between ideas
captions and pills kept off the face
-14 LUFS master

templates.name: Northstar
templates.tagline: Warm, tight podcast look: stacked mixed-size captions with one big cream word and cinematic stills cut in fast
does: stacked captions: tiny lead words, one big cream bold word, a serif word for the emotional beat
a handwriting phrase to close
cinematic stills (sky, lone figure, dark scenes) cut in with the captions kept over them
a light paper concept page where the key word cycles through typefaces
a picture change about every second in busy stretches
captions kept off the face; warm grade with teal shadows
templates.note: The style sets matteWindows (a person cut-out), which is slow on our CPU. Check render time before keeping it as beta.

templates.name: Red Poster
templates.tagline: Black-and-white speaker on a bold red card with one huge white word, and moody cutaways between
does: the speaker in black and white on a wide red card on a white page, or on a full red page
a small red serif lead above and a huge bold white word
moody dark cutaways with small serif and bold sans captions
no header and no name tag
a keys bed under the voice, no sound effects
templates.note: Extends magazine-spread (which sets matteWindows, a person cut-out). Check render time before keeping it as beta.

templates.name: Magazine Spread
templates.tagline: A talking head laid out like a printed magazine: one brand colour, a heavy serif hero word, cream editorial pages
best_for: creators with a strong brand colour
does: one brand colour (maroon by default) owns the frame
a tiny spaced-caps header row and a solid name tag
a heavy serif hero word over a small sans lead-in
colour word pages and cream pages with a kicker, boxed key word and italic deck
the speaker framed as a photo on a coloured page
cool-graded cutaways, hard cuts only
templates.note: The style sets matteWindows (a person cut-out), which is slow on our CPU. Check render time before keeping it as beta.

templates.name: Monochrome Cinema Stark
templates.tagline: The darkest, starkest cinema look: pure white type, one-word black cards, black-and-white cutaways
does: pure white type with no colour accent
tight bold sans small words, bold-italic hero word
frequent black word cards, one word at a time
black-and-white metaphor cutaways and teal-tinted motion-blur crowds
a picture change about every second, heavy dark grade

templates.name: Name Reveal
templates.tagline: Black-and-white world with the speaker in colour, the name huge at head height, one glowing orange word
does: everything behind the speaker in black and white, the speaker in colour
a light-leak open
the name huge in bold white sans, partly hidden by the head
small bold lead lines with one glowing orange serif-italic word
black word cards that blur out
no music bed; bright whooshes on the words and the cuts

templates.name: Empire
templates.tagline: Black-and-white speaker in front of the words: typed cards behind the head, a drop with fast cuts, designed sound
templates.note: Ported from Ahmed's Empire (premium-iman). Since 19 Oct 2026 the speaker's real room is kept (no neon set): the side light is build.mjs's own depth relight (`relight`, needs the depth model; skipped with a warning when it is missing) and the person cut-out is only an occluder for the captions behind the head. Needs the person cut-out, too slow on our CPU to offer yet. empire_finish.py is for the old neon-set look only (it refuses a project without `stage`). Change status to beta when the cut-out is fast.

templates.name: Signature
templates.tagline: Cinematic monologue: hero words that snap the camera in, cutaway scenes, light leaks and a scored mix
templates.note: Ported from Ahmed's Signature. His version used per-video generated art for the cutaways (signature_plan.py), which nothing here makes yet.

templates.name: Prestige
templates.tagline: Clean premium talking head with a timed sound design pass
templates.note: Ported from Ahmed's Prestige (premium-belmar). The sound pass (prestige_score.py + score.py) needs his sound packs, not shipped.
